_comment: ADR-2026-06-01 dialect-parity fixture. Single source of truth for the picomatch@4 glob dialect across BOTH consumers: drift-engine's isFileInDocScope (Story P3.6.1) AND the @delfini/cli expander's effective matching (Story P3.6.2 reuses this exact table). Keep self-contained JSON with no imports so the CLI test can load the identical file. Each row: { name, scope, filePath, expected }.

cases.name: dir entry matches direct .md child
dir entry matches recursive nested child
dir entry does not match sibling tree
dir entry with trailing slash is equivalent
dir entry matches non-md file in subtree (predicate is path-shape-only)
exact file entry matches itself
exact file entry near-miss prefix does not match
exact file entry does not match different dir
single-star glob matches same-dir .md
single-star glob does not cross directory boundary
globstar glob matches nested .md
globstar glob matches root .md
globstar glob does not match non-md
nested single-star glob matches one level
nested single-star glob does not match deeper
multi-entry scope matches via second entry
multi-entry scope matches via dir entry
multi-entry scope matches nothing
empty scope never matches
file path with leading ./ is normalized
dot-prefix scope entry matches its subtree (hidden-dir convention)
extensionless file in dir-scoped subtree matches (path-shape-only)
case-insensitive match aligns with CLI expander default
